about: Controlled vocabulary for image tags. Only these tags can ever be assigned. 'single' facets get exactly one tag per image; 'multi' facets get every tag that clears the threshold. Each tag is described to the model by 'yes' phrases, and multi tags also by 'no' phrases it is weighed against. Edit labels, phrases or thresholds here and re-run tools/tag_images.py.

tags.label: Cover
yes: the front cover of a novel with a printed title and an illustration
a magazine cover with a masthead title
a book cover with the title and the author's name

tags.label: Photograph
yes: a vintage photograph of a person
an old studio photograph
a photographic postcard from the early twentieth century

tags.label: Illustration
yes: a drawn illustration from an old book or magazine
an art deco drawing of a figure
a painted or engraved illustration plate

tags.label: Caricature
yes: a satirical caricature drawing
a humorous cartoon with exaggerated figures
a satirical watercolour cartoon

tags.label: Press page
yes: a page from an old magazine with columns of text and pictures
a newspaper page with photographs and captions

tags.label: Advertisement
yes: a vintage printed advertisement for a product
an old advertisement with a slogan and a price

tags.label: Text page
yes: a page of printed text only
a title page of a book with only text

tags.label: One woman
yes: a picture of one woman alone
a single female figure

tags.label: One man
yes: a picture of one man alone
a single male figure

tags.label: Couple

tags.label: Women together

a crowd of people

a naked figure

tags.label: Outdoors

tags.label: Kiss or embrace
yes: two people kissing

tags.label: Sexual act

explicit pornographic imagery of a sexual act

tags.label: Humour or satire
yes: a humorous or satirical picture making fun of someone
a comic scene

tags.label: Myth or exotic fantasy

a figure as a goddess, nymph, odalisque or devil

a person holding a cigarette or cigarette holder
